theorems.statement: ∀ (P q : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (χ : Eucl P → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) χ → tsupport χ ⊆ U → (∀ x, |χ x| ≤ 1) → ∀ X : GeometricCurrentOn U q, X.mass ≠ ∞ → ∃ Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) q, ∀ (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) q) (η : TestFormOn U q), (∀ x, (η : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) q) x = χ x • (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) q) x) → Y ω = X η
